newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling ends week down on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling ends week down on dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling ended the week weaker compared to the dollar and pound, dealers said.

They said the shilling was posted at a commercial mean rate of 608.0283 versus the dollar on Friday compared to 607.8 on Thursday and 605.8008 on Friday last week. The shilling was quoted at 985.921 compared to 982.9415 on Thursday.
Officials at the central Bank of Tanzania said the shilling fall against the dollar appeared determined by continued dollar strength in international markets.
But commercial dealers also said there was a scarcity of dollars and those who had any did not want to sell.
